findings: Render command-buffer intervals overlap decode intervals and must not be added as independent exclusive stage costs.
The isolated conversion interval is about 2.5-2.7 ms mean at 4K.
Frame validation dominates measured CPU preparation at high payload budgets; command encoding/commit are much smaller.
Dequant versus iDWT hardware cost, CPU frequency/preemption and the live drawable/compositor waits remain unresolved.
